title: TSMC July 2026 Revenue Report (SEC-filed Form 6-K)
publisher: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: July 2026 consolidated revenue was NT$467.58 billion, up 5.6% month over month and 44.7% year over year; January-July revenue rose 37.0%.
summary: The SEC-filed monthly report extends the Q2 demand evidence: July revenue accelerated to NT$467.58 billion and year-to-date revenue reached NT$2,872.06 billion, while providing no margin or customer attribution.
